title: Counital integral diagonal on the cubical lattice resolution
statement:
Let $r\geq0$, $D=\mathbf Z^r$, and $u_1,\ldots,u_r$ its ordered standard basis. Use the integral cubical complex of [lem-sfb-integral-lattice-cubical-contraction]: $C_a$ is the free abelian group on $[v,I]$, with $v\in D$ and $I\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$ of cardinality $a$, zero outside $0\leq a\leq r$, with
$$\partial[v,I]=\sum_{i\in I}(-1)^{\#\{j\in I:j<i\}}([v+u_i,I\setminus\{i\}]-[v,I\setminus\{i\}]).$$
Its augmentation $\varepsilon:C_0\to\mathbf Z$ sends every vertex to $1$. Give the tensor chain complex $C\otimes_{\mathbf Z}C$ differential $\partial(x\otimes y)=\partial x\otimes y+(-1)^a x\otimes\partial y$ for $x\in C_a$, and give it the diagonal translation action. Put $u_A=\sum_{i\in A}u_i$ and $\epsilon(A,C)=(-1)^{\#\{(a,c)\in A\times C:c<a\}}$. The finite formulas
$$\Delta[v,I]=\sum_{A\sqcup C=I}\epsilon(A,C)[v,A]\otimes[v+u_A,C]$$
define a translation-equivariant chain map $\Delta:C\to C\otimes_{\mathbf Z}C$. Under the canonical unit identifications,
$$(\varepsilon\otimes1)\Delta=1=(1\otimes\varepsilon)\Delta,\qquad (\varepsilon\otimes\varepsilon)\Delta=\varepsilon.$$
The last equality is an equality of augmented chain maps to $\mathbf Z[0]$. For $r=0$, $\Delta(1)=1\otimes1$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-cubical-partition-boundary-expansion] to the displayed $\Delta$: its $P(v,I)$ is exactly $\Delta[v,I]$. For each removed $i$, the sign $(-1)^{\#\{j\in I:j<i\}}$ does not depend on $(B,C)$, and the remaining inner sum over $B\sqcup C=I\setminus\{i\}$ of its boundary expansion is $\Delta[v+u_i,I\setminus\{i\}]-\Delta[v,I\setminus\{i\}]$, by the defining formula of $\Delta$ on $I\setminus\{i\}$ and $u_i+u_B=u_B+u_i$. Hence the $i$-th outer summand is $\Delta$ applied to the $i$-th summand $(-1)^{\#\{j\in I:j<i\}}([v+u_i,I\setminus\{i\}]-[v,I\setminus\{i\}])$ of $\partial[v,I]$, and the expansion is $\Delta\partial[v,I]$. Equality on the free basis, including the empty set and zero source degrees, proves the chain-map condition of [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].

proof.text: In [lem-sfb-graded-partition-counit-evaluation] take $E=\{1,\ldots,r\}$, $X=\mathbf Z^r$, $t_A(v)=v+u_A$, and $c(A,C)=\epsilon(A,C)$. The empty sum gives $t_\varnothing=1$ and either empty part gives inversion count zero, hence coefficient $1$. The augmentation condition $\varepsilon\partial_1=0$ is supplied by [lem-sfb-integral-lattice-cubical-contraction]. The lemma gives both projected formulas and the canonical unit identifications, with differential compatibility, and gives the double projection $\varepsilon$. Together with step 2 these are exactly the three required equalities of chain maps.
